comment: kiln.rules client guards (the game client only; docs/re/client.md, 'The camera, health-bar line of sight, and a frozen client'). rules.healthbar_guard: fill_ui_healthbar's line of sight from the camera to each health bar (a camera 2^31 m off made every ray walk ~1.5e9 voxel cells). rules.camera_check: a read-only look at the camera ClientPlayerInput gets each frame. Found on client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1...); every pattern is pinned to its function (scoped) and its layout constants are fixed, so another build refuses them instead of hooking the wrong place.

rules/client.Healthbar.comment: fill_ui_healthbar (client program) update: iterator setup (0xf0 bytes), the local player's entity from LocalPlayerData +4

@rules/client.Healthbar.player.comment: the local player's RenderTransform position, kept for the whole loop: x in xmm14, y in xmm15 (int64 32.32 x 2^-32), z at [rbp + hb.player_z]; the loop's distance test reads them unchanged

find.pattern: 48 8B 45 78 41 8D 76 01 F3 0F 10 85 {rules/client.hb.player_z:d32} 0F 57 FF 45 0F 57 C0 45 0F 57 C9 41 0F 28 CE 41 0F 28 F7

rules/client.HealthbarRay.comment: the call of the line-of-sight test (rcx = result, rdx = the ray's start: the camera, float3 at [rbp-0x20]; r8 = its end: the entity + 1.5 m, float3 at [rbp-0x30]); the mid hook goes on the call

@rules/client.LineOfSight.check.comment: the called function is the line-of-sight test (voxel DDA and collider ray) as on 26430625

rules/client.CameraInput.comment: where the client fills ClientPlayerInput.camera (r14 = the local player's ClientPlayerInput, camera at +cpi.camera; rbp = the client game, its camera object at [rbp + cam.obj]) from the camera transform; the mid hook goes right after the last field (also the target of the 'no camera object' branch)

@rules/client.CameraTransform.fields.comment: the camera transform: pivot (WorldPosition) + offset turned by three quaternions - distance x forward; the fields the camera check reports

rules/client.FogDiscover.comment: creative map reveal: FogDiscover(FogOfWar*, const float2* posXZ, float range), the fog_of_war system's per-frame discover call (its only caller); range is a diameter in metres (radius = range / 2). Client 26430625 0x3a2780 (docs/re/creative-mode-146.md Part 3, section 1)

@rules/client.FogDiscover.caller.comment: the fog_of_war system's call (xmm2 = FogOfWarDiscovery.discoveryRange): FogDiscover is the function it calls

find.pattern: F3 0F 59 C6 F3 0F 59 CE F3 0F 11 84 24 80 00 00 00 F3 0F 11 8C 24 84 00 00 00 F3 0F 10 10 E8 {rules/client.FogDiscover:rel32}

rules/client.CraftableAmount.comment: creative craft buttons: UiCraftableAmount(gameUi, u32 recipe, u16 cap, const RecipeInputCategorySelections*) -> u32, the crafting menu's (and the flame altar's) craftable count, a cached lookup; the craft actions are enabled from it. Client 26430625 0xb2ddd0
